integrations.name: Benchling Integration
integrations.description: Connect to Benchling biotech R&D platform for sample management, sequence design, lab notebook integration, and workflow automation.
integrations.help_text: Requires Benchling API key. Enterprise feature - contact Benchling for access.
integrations.scientific_context: LIMS, electronic lab notebook, sample tracking, biotech R&D

integrations.name: Opentrons Integration
integrations.description: Interface with Opentrons liquid handling robots. Upload protocols, monitor runs, and integrate automated experiments into workflows.
integrations.help_text: Requires Opentrons robot connected to network. Use Opentrons App for initial setup.
integrations.scientific_context: Lab automation, liquid handling, high-throughput screening, protocol execution

integrations.name: DNAnexus Integration
integrations.description: Connect to DNAnexus cloud genomics platform for large-scale data analysis, secure collaboration, and compliance workflows.
integrations.help_text: Requires DNAnexus account and API token. dx login for authentication.
integrations.scientific_context: Cloud genomics, HIPAA compliance, large-scale analysis, UK Biobank

integrations.name: LatchBio Integration
integrations.description: Interface with Latch bioinformatics cloud platform. Deploy workflows, manage data, and run analysis pipelines.
integrations.help_text: Requires Latch account. Use latch login for authentication.
integrations.scientific_context: Cloud bioinformatics, workflow deployment, data management

integrations.name: OMERO Integration
integrations.description: Connect to OMERO imaging data management platform. Access, annotate, and analyze microscopy images.
integrations.help_text: Requires OMERO server access. Open source - can be self-hosted.
integrations.scientific_context: Microscopy, image management, bioimage analysis, data sharing

integrations.name: LabArchive Integration
integrations.description: Connect to LabArchives electronic lab notebook for experiment documentation, data linking, and compliance.
integrations.help_text: Requires LabArchives account and API access token.
integrations.scientific_context: Electronic lab notebook, experiment documentation, compliance, data provenance
